acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass plays recordings from the Satanic Prayer Line, and speaks to the line’s creator, Chris Allert. (8 1/2 minutes)

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
New Yorker staff writer Kelefa Sanneh tells the story of exorcist Bob Larson’s trip into the world of heavy metal.
Bob Guccione Jr., interviewed in this story, runs the website Wonderlust.
acts.title: Record Deal with the Devil

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Religion professor Elaine Pagels explains the roots and evolution of Satan in religious texts. She is the author of " The Origin of Satan."
acts.title: Details of the Devil

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Writer Gary Shteyngart presents a fictional diary of two Russian men — and a story of the special malevolence that can grow from an intimate situation. A portion of the story is read by actor Josh Gad. Gary Shteyngart’s most recent book is " Lake Success.”
acts.title: The Devil You Know
